business_summary: Patterson-UTI Energy, Inc., through its subsidiaries, provides drilling and completion services to oil and natural gas exploration and production companies in the United States, Canada, Colombia, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Drilling Services, Completion Services, and Drilling Products. The Contract Drilling Services segment engages in the provision of contract and directional drilling, and measurement-while-drilling (MWD) services in onshore oil and natural gas basins; supply and rental of downhole performance motors, such as Mpact drilling motors, and Mpower MWD systems; electrical controls and automation to the energy, marine, and mining industries; rig fleet evaluation; and drilling technology service. This segment also provides software and services, such as MWD Survey Fault Detection, Isolation and Recovery (FDIR) services, a data analytics technology to analyze MWD survey data in real-time and identify the position of a well; HiFi Nav, which enhances FDIR by targeting improved vertical placement of the directional well within the reservoir; and HiFi Guidance that utilizes trajectory optimization to determine optimal steering recommendations and placement within the reservoir. The Completion Services segment offers services for hydraulic fracturing, wireline and pumping, completion support, equipment, materials, and cementing, as well as involved in the power solutions natural gas fueling, and last mile logistics and storage businesses. The Drilling Products segment engages in the design, manufacture, sale, and rental of matrix and steel-bodied polycrystalline diamond compact drill bits. It also rents oilfield tools; and offers specialized services for land-based oil and natural gas drilling, completion, and workover activities. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas.
business_summary_ko: Patterson-UTI Energy, Inc.는 자회사를 통해 미국, 캐나다, 콜롬비아 및 해외의 석유 및 천연가스 탐사 및 생산 회사에 시추 및 완료 서비스를 제공합니다. 드릴링 서비스, 완료 서비스 및 드릴링 제품의 세 가지 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 계약 시추 서비스 부문은 육상 석유 및 천연가스 유역에서 계약 및 방향성 시추, 시추 중 측정(MWD) 서비스를 제공합니다. Mpact 드릴링 모터 및 Mpower MWD 시스템과 같은 다운홀 성능 모터의 공급 및 임대; 에너지, 해양 및 광산업에 대한 전기 제어 및 자동화; 장비 함대 평가; 및 드릴링 기술 서비스. 이 부문은 또한 MWD 조사 데이터를 실시간으로 분석하고 유정의 위치를 ​​식별하는 데이터 분석 기술인 MWD 조사 오류 감지, 격리 및 복구(FDIR) 서비스와 같은 소프트웨어 및 서비스를 제공합니다. 저수지 내 방향성 우물의 수직 배치 개선을 목표로 하여 FDIR을 향상시키는 HiFi Nav; 최적의 조향 권장 사항을 결정하기 위해 궤적 최적화를 활용하는 HiFi 안내
